verdict.rationale: Codegen's own docs say agents run and test code in isolated environments, and there is a first-party sandbox API for analyzing setup logs. This is true sandbox isolation, not a dry-run mode. However, nothing explicitly documents that production data and credentials are kept out of these sandboxes, or how environments are separated from production. missing for 10: explicit documentation of production-data separation, details of the sandbox isolation boundaries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Safely run code, install dependencies, and test changes in robust isolated environments
This endpoint creates an AI agent that will analyze the setup logs from a sandbox
